source: Advanced short story written in spoken Palestinian by Claude. NOT native-validated.

sentences.ar: جاري أبو نبيل كان يعزف عود من زمان.
sentences.en: My neighbor Abu Nabil used to play the oud long ago.

sentences.ar: كل مسا، كنا نسمع صوت عوده من الشباك.
sentences.en: Every evening, we would hear the sound of his oud from the window.

sentences.ar: اللحن كان حزين حلو، بيمس القلب.
sentences.en: The melody was sad and sweet, touching the heart.

sentences.ar: مرة، سألته: ليش ألحانك حزينة يا عمو؟
sentences.en: Once, I asked him: why are your melodies sad, uncle?
He put the oud beside him, and told me his story.

sentences.ar: قال إنه كان عنده بنت بتحب الموسيقى.
sentences.en: He said he had a daughter who loved music.

sentences.ar: كانت تقعد جنبه وتسمعه وهو يعزف.
sentences.en: She used to sit beside him and listen as he played.

sentences.ar: بس البنت مرضت وتوفت وهي صغيرة.
sentences.en: But the daughter got sick and passed away while young.

sentences.ar: من يومها، صار يعزف عشانها هي.
sentences.en: From that day, he started playing for her.

sentences.ar: قال: العزف بيخليها قريبة من قلبي.
sentences.en: He said: playing keeps her close to my heart.
I heard his story, and my eyes teared up.

sentences.ar: من هديك اليوم، صرت أسمع عزفه بشكل تاني.
sentences.en: From that day, I began to hear his playing differently.

sentences.ar: كل لحن كان يحكي عن محبة أب لبنته.
sentences.en: Every melody spoke of a father's love for his daughter.

sentences.ar: قلتله: عزفك بيخلي بنتك حية بقلوبنا كلنا.
sentences.en: I told him: your playing keeps your daughter alive in all our hearts.

sentences.ar: ابتسم بحزن، ورجع يعزف لحنه الحلو.
sentences.en: He smiled sadly, and went back to playing his sweet melody.
